title: QCrunchy Korean Eggplant Grill
description: A nutty, creamy brunch-mood dish featuring grilled eggplants with a green-curry paste base, high in protein and ready to be served on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat binchotan grill to high heat.
Slice eggplant into rounds about 1/4 inch thick.
Mix green curry paste with soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Brush both sides of each slice with the mixed sauce evenly.
Grill slices until golden brown and slightly charred on both sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Sprinkle sesame seeds over grilled eggplant for additional texture and flavor.
Serve hot as a high-protein-friendly brunch dish.
